def mblocks(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); m=[(i,j) for i in range(10,63) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='M']
    # cluster into 2x2 blocks by connected components
    import collections
    seen=set(); blocks=[]
    for (i,j) in m:
        if (i,j) in seen: continue
        stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            x,y=stack.pop()
            if (x,y) in seen: continue
            seen.add((x,y)); comp.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (x+dx,y+dy) in m and (x+dx,y+dy) not in seen: stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
        blocks.append(comp)
    return blocks
def right_block(fr):
    bs=mblocks(fr)
    # the one with cols ~36-37
    for b in bs:
        cols=[c for (r,c) in b]
        if 35<=min(cols)<=38: return b
    return None
b=right_block(current_frame)
print("start right block",sorted(b))
for k in range(8):
    b=right_block(current_frame)
    if not b: print("no right block"); break
    rows=[r for (r,c) in b]; cols=[c for (r,c) in b]
    tr=(min(rows),max(cols))
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':tr[0],'col':tr[1]}])
    b2=right_block(current_frame)
    rows2=[r for (r,c) in b2] if b2 else []
    print(f"iter{k}: clicked {tr}, now rows {min(rows2) if rows2 else None}-{max(rows2) if rows2 else None}")
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("COMPLETED"); break
print("done",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
